Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Ma...@worldcom.com wrote:
> Hidden Lurker. The card specifies that the opposing minion
> cannot use any strikes during the first round of combat.
> Does this include hand damage?

The restriction prevents the minion from making any strike,
including a hand strike, yes.
